structured.answer: I understood that a fixed deposit pays a set interest for the agreed time, and that I give up taking the money out early: I need the bank's agreement and may pay a fine the site doesn't calculate. It also says deposits aren't insured, which scared me, so I'll ask my son and the bank before I do anything.
